title: The Field of Flowers
text: White flowers to the horizon, under a sky that is for once only a sky. No birds sing. No wind moves the petals. The air is sweet and the ground is soft, and there is nothing wrong here at all, which is the most wrong thing you have seen in days.

options.label: Lie down among the flowers and rest.

outcomes.text: You sleep in the flowers and wake whole. There was no catch.

options.label: Don't trust it. Keep walking, eyes down.

outcomes.text: You walk through quickly, eyes down. Afterwards, some of you wish you had stayed.
